Hi Ava,

Thanks for taking this. We're kicking off procurement for a project that will put some production traffic to Redwood in Q3. Before the SOW gets final approval, procurement and our security team need a copy of your latest SOC 2 Type II report and a bridge letter if the report's audit period doesn't cover our planned start date (2026-07-01).

Two quick clarifications:
- Can you confirm the audit period covered by your most recent Type II?
- If the period ends before 2026-07-01, do you provide a bridge letter that states there were no material changes since the report date?

We typically ask for a presigned link for report artifacts or an SFTP. If you prefer a portal transfer, that works too — just let us know timing.

Appreciate a reply with a short checklist of what you can share and any standard wording you use for bridge letters.

Regards,
Jordan Riley
Senior Security Engineer | CloudWave

Hi Jordan —

Thanks for the clear ask. Short answers up front:
- Our latest SOC 2 Type II (security + availability) covers 2025-10-01 through 2026-03-31.
- We do provide a limited bridge letter for customers that explains the scope and confirms no material changes to the control environment since the report date; it is not a replacement for a full report.

What we can share today (and how):
1) Redacted SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) via presigned S3 link or secure portal.
2) Standard bridge letter template (PDF) we can customize with your target start date.
3) Control maps: short CSV that maps common SIG/CAIQ questions to report sections (redwood-proc-controlmap.csv).
4) List of retained logs and retention windows (one-page doc).

Next steps I recommend:
- Tell me which delivery method you prefer (presigned S3 link vs secure portal). We can generate a presigned link that expires in 7 days.
- Confirm the exact date you want the bridge letter to reference (e.g., 2026-07-01).
- If you need narrower redaction (remove customer names or telemetry samples), note that now; redaction adds 1 business day.

I've attached a short intake template (20260523-ava-soc2-req-template.pdf) with the artifacts we typically include and a sample reply matrix your procurement can paste into their intake tracker. If helpful, Marissa can produce the bridge letter draft once you confirm the date.

Best,
Ava Chen
Trust & Security | Redwood Inference
